highlights: Noise/grain texture overlay applied to images and surfaces using image-set() with AVIF fallback and PNG backup (noise.24b8225d.png / noise@20aq.289c1f1d.avif), 50% opacity, mix-blend-overlay mode, 256px scale (128px at 2x resolution)
Soft shadows: box-shadow: 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04) on buttons and cards
Ring borders with inset style: 0.5px ring with black/7.5% opacity for subtle borders
Pointer-event masked scrolling with linear-gradient masks for edge fades
Rounded full elements (circular avatars, buttons) with overflow hidden and noise overlay
Black opacity overlays at various levels: /5 (0.05), /7.5 (0.075), /10 (0.1), /15 (0.15), /20 (0.2) for surface depth
Backdrop blur effects implied by contextual nav and floating panels (though not explicitly shown in visible styles)
